title: Pão de Queijo
description: Pão de Queijo is a dish from Brazil featuring whole cow milk, tapioca starch, parmigiano reggiano, mozzarella. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 8 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Gradually pour the hot milk-oil mixture over tapioca starch; cool until safe to handle, then add eggs and cheese and knead gently.
Divide and shape the prepared mixture or dough into even portions and arrange on a lined baking sheet or appropriate molds, leaving enough room for expansion.
Bake the already topped dough in a fully preheated 230–250°C oven until the base is crisp and toppings are cooked.
